name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
one_liner: A massive free course, 523 lessons long, that teaches you to build AI systems and agents step by step, with real reusable code for every lesson.
buyer: A corporate learning-and-development team or coding bootcamp that wants ready-made, structured AI-engineering training content to run cohorts on, instead of building a curriculum from scratch.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp licenses or forks the curriculum as the backbone of a paid 'AI Engineer' certificate program with live cohorts and mentorship.
A company's L&D team runs internal upskilling sessions using the free lessons, paying only for an instructor to guide employees through it.
A career coach builds a paid placement-prep service ('portfolio review + interview prep') targeted at people who complete the free curriculum.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid cohort-based course with live instruction, code review, and a certificate, built on top of the free material.
License a customized/branded version of the curriculum to corporate training teams.

steal_this: This weekend, pick one phase (e.g. Agent Engineering), turn it into a 2-week paid cohort with live office hours, and sell 10 seats to test demand before building anything bigger.
